description: Returns the form of one kind of asset or debt on the My Assets page: the field keys, the labels, the options, the required fields, and the module_state. Call it before add_asset or update_asset. When module_state is closed, do not collect values: give the customer next_step_url. Otherwise ask the customer for each required value. For a bank account, a credit card, an investment, or a debt, when the result gives plaid_connection_url (for example /prenup/my-assets/bank), offer two choices: the customer connects the account through Plaid in the app, or gives the account here for add_asset. A Plaid connection in the app also restarts the alignment when module_state is edit_restarts_alignment, so get the same yes first. Never ask for the sign-in details of an account.

kind.description: The kind of asset or debt.

name: describe_asset_form

module_state.description: The state of the module for a write of the customer. open: a write saves. edit_restarts_alignment: a write saves, restarts the alignment of the couple, and can email the partner. Tell the customer this and get a yes before the write. closed: the tools refuse a write. Do not collect values. Give the customer next_step_url.

next_step_url.description: Only for a closed module: the app page that shows the next step.

plaid_connection_url.description: Only for a bank, a credit card, an investment, or a debt when the module is not closed: the app page that connects the account through Plaid. It needs a computer: the app does not show My Assets on a phone.

title: Describe an asset form
